title: The `UpdateContainer` and `GetContainerConfig` APIs in the BoltDB state can be removed
body: While BoltDB support is removed from Podman 6, we retained very minimal support to ensure that we could migrate legacy databases to SQLite. As part of this, we slimmed down the BoltDB code to remove functions that were now unnecessary, but we missed a few. The `UpdateContainer` and `GetContainerConfig` functions are now entirely unused and can be removed without issue.
